# DIYTrade.com

> > DIYTrade.com is a B2B trading platform connecting global buyers with Chinese suppliers and manufacturers through product directories, free website builders, and membership services.

DIYTrade.com operates as a comprehensive B2B marketplace and supplier directory platform with headquarters in major Chinese cities like Shenzhen and Shanghai. The platform offers both free and premium membership tiers with integrated website building, SEO optimization, and business analytics tools for small businesses and manufacturers.

## Key Topics

- B2B Platform
- China Suppliers
- Supplier Directory
- Product Catalog
- Website Builder
- Free Registration
- Member Services
- SEO Optimization

- Shenzhen

## Core Platform & Access

- [DIYTrade Homepage](https://www.diytrade.com): DIYTrade homepage: China B2B platform with product directory
- [China B2B Trading Platform](https://www.diytrade.com/china/main.html): DIYTrade China B2B trading platform with supplier directory
- [Chinese B2B Platform](https://cn.diytrade.com): Chinese B2B trading platform for suppliers and manufacturers
- [User Registration](https://my.diytrade.com/diyep/siteMain/main/registration): User registration page for DIYTrade.com account signup
- [Member Login & Dashboard](https://my.diytrade.com/diyep/siteMain/main/mgr): DIYTrade.com user login and dashboard management page
- [Website Platform](https://my.diytrade.com/diyep/site): DIYTrade.com B2B platform homepage with seller registration

## Membership & Services

- [Free Website Builder](https://www.diytrade.com/free-website.html): Free website builder service for small business on DIYTrade
- [Free Member Service](https://www.diytrade.com/china/service/freeserv/Free_Member.html): Free membership service with website builder and SEO tools
- [BizMember Premium Service](https://www.diytrade.com/china/service/bizserv/Biz_Member.html): BizMember premium service plans and membership comparison

## Member Management Tools

- [Product Management](https://my.diytrade.com/diyep/siteMain/product/productTable): Product management table for DIYTrade.com members
- [Content & Topic Management](https://my.diytrade.com/diyep/siteMain/main/topic): Topic and content management for DIYTrade member websites
- [Promotion & Marketing](https://my.diytrade.com/diyep/siteMain/main/mgr_promotion): Promotion and marketing management for DIYTrade members
- [Account Settings](https://my.diytrade.com/diyep/siteMain/main/opt): Account settings and options management page

## Business Analytics & Reporting

- [Inquiry Reports](https://my.diytrade.com/diyep/siteMain/report/rpt_enqlist): Inquiry reports and analytics for DIYTrade.com members
- [Business Dashboard](https://my.diytrade.com/diyep/siteMain/main/mgr_report): Business reporting and statistics dashboard for members
